attribution.title: Leidsestraat 40, Amsterdam: neo-renaissance corner house with an oriel turret (1881)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012176402 (CC0): the corbelled oxblood oriel turret with its tower stage and zinc spire, the bust and carved consoles under it, the round-arched shop windows with stained fanlights under the sculpted frieze, the stepped dormer gable, the paired windows on figure mullions under broken pediments, the stone bands, hoods and wall anchors, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
